name: Daytona
product: Daytona 2.0 at daytona.com (docs v2.0, launched 1 November 2026). Daytona 1.x at daytona.io, which the 2.0 docs call v0, is still sold but no longer described here.
disclosure: Disclosure: battleships.dev, cited in this document, is built by the Boat team; Boat is one of the providers compared here. It is used as a cross-check, never as the sole source of a rate or verdict.

regions.value: earth (1.0x), us (1.15x), us-east (1.75x), us-east-ash-1 and us-east-bos-1 (2.0x), plus macos-1. No European region is documented.
regions.quote: United States us · 1.15× US East (Ashburn) us-east · 1.75× Ashburn us-east-ash-1 · 2.0× Boston us-east-bos-1 · 2.0×

limits.maxSize: 4 cores (8 vCPU) / 16 GiB per sandbox (limits page); the pricing table says 64 cores / 128 GiB

plans.name: Team
plans.includedUsage: $100 of credits a month, expiring at the end of the billing period.

limits.maxSize: 8 cores (16 vCPU) / 32 GiB per sandbox (limits page)

plans.quote: The Team plan has a monthly fee of $250, billed in advance, and includes $100 of credits each month that expire at the end of the billing period.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.includedUsage: Custom; BYOC, SSO, audit logs, HIPAA, KVM.

limits.maxSize: 64 cores / 256 GiB plan caps, above the 16-core platform maximum

plans.quote: Audit logs, SSO, HIPAA, Trust Center access

rates.quote: | AMD Zen 3 · Intel Ice Lake · AWS Graviton 4 · Apple M4 | $0.0706 | $0.101 |

coreToVcpu.value: 1 core = 2 vCPU where SMT is on, 1 vCPU otherwise (Graviton, Apple). The per-vCPU rate above assumes SMT.
coreToVcpu.quote: One core is equivalent to 2 vCPUs where SMT (simultaneous multithreading, also called hyperthreading) is available and enabled, and 1 vCPU otherwise.

cpuBasisNote.value: The guarantee is billed whether used or not; usage above it, up to the limit, is billed as measured.
cpuBasisNote.quote: CPU and memory usage within the guarantee is billed at the guarantee; usage above it, up to the sandbox's resource limits, is billed as measured.

billingIncrement.value: Per second from start until stop, pause or delete.
billingIncrement.quote: Daytona meters each sandbox per second for three resources, from the moment the sandbox starts until it is stopped, paused, or deleted.

multipliers.value: Spot 0.7x; CPU type 1.0 / 1.6667 / 2.3313 ($0.101 / $0.168 / $0.235 a core-hour); region 1.0-2.0x. They compound.
multipliers.quote: Each dimension applies a multiplier to the base price; the multipliers compound.

spot.value: 0.7x CPU, memory and disk; reclaimable; GPU sandboxes cannot be spot.
spot.quote: Spot multiplies the CPU, memory, and disk price by 0.7

classes.name: Linux (Firecracker)
classes.quote: A Linux sandbox may guarantee at most 16 cores, 32GiB memory, and 256GiB disk.

classes.name: Windows
classes.rates: $0.172 per core-hour OS rate on demand. Its own docs page says coming soon.
classes.quote: Windows sandboxes for Daytona v2 are coming soon.

classes.name: macOS
classes.rates: $2.5032 per Mac-hour reservation, $60.08 per 24-hour period, instead of the meter.
classes.quote: The price of one reservation of this model is **$2.5032 per Mac-hour, $60.08 per 24-hour period**.

idle.value: Idle timeout off by default, minimum 60 s, deletes a Linux sandbox. Wall-clock timeout capped at 24 h (Starter) / 48 h (Team).
idle.quote: The idle timeout is off by default unless the project sets one, has a minimum of 60 seconds, and requires an action.

disk.included: All ephemeral disk is free; it is deleted with the sandbox.
disk.quote: No. CPU and memory are billed only while a sandbox is running, and ephemeral NVMe disk is free. A stopped or paused sandbox keeps its state and is not metered. Volumes are billed separately.

volume.value: 1-1000 GiB, up to 8 per sandbox. Whether size or used bytes is billed is not published; modelled on size.
volume.quote: A sandbox attaches up to 8 volumes, and several sandboxes can attach the same volume at once.

billedWhenStopped.value: A Linux sandbox cannot stop or pause; a deleted sandbox bills only its volumes. Stopped Windows bills nothing.
billedWhenStopped.quote: Stopped, paused, and deleted sandboxes are not metered for CPU, memory, or disk.

snapshot.value: No snapshot or image storage price is published.

egress.value: No outbound byte price or allowance. Bucket-volume traffic bills per uploaded GiB, downloaded GiB and 1,000 requests at unpublished rates.
egress.quote: Bucket volume traffic is billed per uploaded GiB, downloaded GiB, and 1,000 requests

freeTier.what: $200 one-time credit on Starter, no card. No recurring free allowance.
freeTier.quote: Build for free, pay as you scale. $200 in free compute included, no credit card required.
freeTier.creditNote: Billing describes one grant on connecting a card and another on verifying email; pricing says one-time $200. Unresolved.

cases.note: Starter, on demand, earth region; worked in research/daytona2-2026-11-12.md section 3.5.
